title: AIEditing format profile
description: Answers of the interview for one editing format; data only, no secrets.

skill_name.description: Folder name under ~/.agents/skills/: no separators, no leading or trailing dot (rules out '.', '..', hidden names).

source_speed.description: How much the source was already sped up; `speed` is what is added to the file.

cta_lead.description: Seconds before the end of the speech the call to action comes.

cta_tail.description: Seconds it stands after the end of the speech; part of `max_seconds`.

safe.description: The kit's preset of the zone text keeps to; `reels` keeps clear of what Reels, Shorts and TikTok cover.

covers.description: How many vertical covers the format makes.

like.description: The catalog format a format under the person's own word is narrowed from: its paths hold for this one.

variant.description: The path chosen for a format with `variants` in catalog/formats.json, or own:<word> for one the catalog does not have.

key_file.description: Path to a .env the person already keeps the key in (~ allowed); the key is read from it at run time under api_key_env and never copied.

animations.description: Animated inserts (step `animations`, HyperFrames): at most one per `every` seconds; `seconds` fixes their length (else 4–8 s by the number of points).

cta_parts.description: The call to action of a re-edit, as it is drawn: a lead line, then the word the viewer writes between what stands before and after it. null: the person said the clips go without one.
